timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I'm not feeling very motivated this morning.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to stay right where I am.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay that I'm not full of energy yet.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don't need to feel ready to begin.
I can let a little momentum build.
My energy can grow as the morning goes on.
I don't have to have it all figured out before I start.
I'm allowed to ease into today.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm ready to meet this day.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Take this lightness with you into what's next.
